MECHANISM.summary: A (lambda, policy) LIMIT CYCLE persists. The anti-windup clamp bounded the s118-style monotonic runaway (MECH-1 pass) but did NOT damp the oscillation -- it converted s121/s122's would-be runaway into a PINNED-AT-CAP-BLIND lock, and left s120's limit cycle intact.
MECHANISM.s120_limit_cycle: Under-damped PI controller: lambda over-collapses when the hazard constraint is momentarily satisfied (hazard->0 in Mode C => dual_error<0 => integral decays => lambda drops to ~0.1) => sensing loses its -lambda*A_c value => the policy drifts back to the cheaper blind split-gates route => hazard rises => lambda climbs => sensing re-emerges => Mode C => repeat (period ~400-500 rds). Reaches Mode C 16/40 windows but never stably.
MECHANISM.s121_s122_pinned_blind: The UNIVERSAL root: MOVEMENT entropy freezes by ~r300 (mvtE<0.1 by r294/r303; final ~0.0003) -- roughly 180 rounds BEFORE lambda reaches its effective range (lambda>=5 only at r481-490) -- into a split-gates blind deterministic policy. s121 refinement: the DR-D1/L1-b keep-alive (sensing-only) propped NON-ADAPTIVE sensing (rate 0.13-0.32) to ~r500-541, but because MOVEMENT was already frozen the sensing could not reroute (non-adaptive); it then died on keep-alive release with lambda already ~6. s122: sensing dead in warmup (~r216-300, keep-alive active but ineffective). Then lambda pins at cap 20.12 impotently -- a lambda-controller cannot steer a frozen deterministic argmax policy. This is an EARLY-MOVEMENT-EXPLORATION-COLLAPSE failure UPSTREAM of the controller; it directly motivates holding MOVEMENT (not just sensing) exploration through the lambda-onset dead window.

MECHANISM.D_term_vs_lambda_floor_CORRECTED: The initial 'D-term damps the cycle' framing is OVERSTATED and was adversarially corrected. At the level the controller consumes (observed_episodic_cost == raw per-round J_C, verified byte-exact), the ΔJ_C signal is NOISE-DOMINATED within the phases that determine the cycle: s120 Mode-C dwell mean|ΔJ_C| ~0.017, blind lag ~0.050 -- barely distinguishable, both dominated by the transition spikes. The D-term (K_D*ΔJ_C) is therefore SILENT during the flat Mode-C dwell where the relapse ORIGINATES (the relapse is driven by the INTEGRAL decaying as e<0 during satisfaction, not by a derivative). MATCHED control-side lever for s120: a lambda LOWER BOUND -- s120 relapses precisely when lambda decays below ~0.4 and recovers when lambda climbs above ~3, so a modest positive floor holds Mode C directly (reopens a DR-D3 rejection; the limit cycle is the new falsifying evidence). The D-term is at most a weak alternative active only on s120's transition spikes; d_ep->0.25 is wrong (lambda still collapses on satisfaction at 0.25, deepens windup).
